meta.title: feat: add framework-agnostic googleapis caching layer to prevent rate limiting
meta.body_summary: Adds a framework-agnostic caching layer for Google Calendar API calls to prevent rate limit exhaustion, with Edge (Next.js) and Redis (Nest.js) cache clients integrated at CalendarAuth level.
